newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine 1996 bolsa volume at record high.
newsitem.headline: Argentine 1996 bolsa volume at record high.

text.p: Turnover on the Argentine bolsa soared 66 percent to record levels in 1996, the Buenos Aires stock exchange said Friday.
Combined floor and over-the-counter deals in 1996 stood at $166.7 billion last Friday, compared with $100.43 billion in 1995 and $128.9 billion in 1994, the bolsa said in a news release.
However, floor volume shrank to $464 million in 1996, compared with $480 million in 1995, $1.1 billion in 1994, $1.0 billion in 1993 and $1.6 billion in 1992.
The blue-chip MerVal index closed slightly above 650 last Friday, showing a gain of 25 percent for the year and reaching its highest level since February 28, 1994.
This year the bolsa authorized 233 government bond issues worth $16.8 billion and introduced seven new stock listings.
